book.name: 2 Korinti
book.title: PAS NAMBA TU PAULO MENI KORINTI EMARE GAENUA

content: Paulo meni Korinti nate kaka ewesemamu wenua amira ge.
Na nisokare nana muro nikare gona wero duba nai noko nimorekare tamai azu, na kotumuro kaka mamu dotisena.

Nane duba nai nimorekare tamana amire ai meni duba nai naso kora wamunoi? Na kora wai ema kau wamena. Nera kota, na duba nai nimorekare tamamena sia, awa gona wana duba namunowa ami nogo wero duba nai naso kora wamewi?

Ge zo nisokare nana itewia awa kaka kora wamu wawa na mana nikare duba ewanana wai ine ami namore duba nai tamai azu, na gita pas gaero ge awa kora wawa tepo waise sisena awa. Na nimorekare ego ine kotumena zewai wisia awa: “Ge awa kora wara tepo wai amire na yawa sara wamunona. Noko nane yawa sara wana amire Korinti ema bama dapikarago yawa sara wamunora.”

Na moka naso meni mou weti nikare emo yaya pei oko tapinoise di dai toise nimorekare pas gaisena awa. Awa nikare duba nai bamu tamawise kota, duba naso nisokare nana zewai-zawai itewia, awa gawise sero pas awa gaisena awa.
Paulo meni Korinti ema zo pasina wenua amira pasina duarise senua.

Nisokare nana zo meni duba nai tamunua ami namore kota, nimorekare duba nai tamunua; noko na nu gera potiro ge bamubake toise nikare dapikarago amire tamunua ago oko samunona. Nu nisokare nana enire wenua asinona.
Nikare dainiro meni nu damu potisewa awa gena te inoya.
Are nu pasina nuso emo duba nai bamure noma gera wai azu, nikare pasina nuso dotinoise uzutiro kora-makora wewo.
Ami emo nikare noko numore otao inoise dumi pawise tona awa.
Na gita nikare gaero gamu sero pas gaisena, awa ge naso dapikarago dimamunowita damunowi, awa gamu sero gaisena awa.
Nikare ema zora pasina duawa na da ago duamunona awa. Pasina tamunua ami pasina namore wenuta pasina awa dotinona. Na pasina nuso dotinoise nikare kotupitinoise Kristora giti mokara ena dotinona awa.
Awa Satan meni nakai puro osai azu, ago inona. Nu namorekai waya wamu kotupitinowia awa oko kau inonakai.
Paulo Troas nate ena Tito kau wero duba mou wenua.
Na Troas nate kei awetena Kristora Oziga Ewanana sanise amira ebata Tua meni namore gatisia awa.
Ata otao naso Tito nu nisokare nana ena eya kaka ewesemamu wisia, are na nu kau wero duba naso mou weti giro Troas ema doro nu tamamu sero Masedonia zebura musena ewa.

Ata Anutura zazo de ike nanekai! Nu nakare soremuro gita wawi nakare Kristora putou meni iwo nuso puro osisinowenakare. Nu nakare buara iyetawi bayawenakare ibosi zamare meni so topetitinowia, ago ine ge nuso meni zebu sero topetiro susawewia.

Nakare zama ewanana ine inowenakare. Zama ami Anutura nana kei awawi imawi Kristora zama ewanana inowia. Zama ami ema ewanana waira ebatara nowera, ata ema gera waira ebatara nowera, amira nana kei awinowia awa.

Are gera waira ebatara nowera nukare zama awa imawera nusokare nana toiro dawi betinowera awa. Ata ewanana waira ebatara nowera nukare awa imawera mokara toiro nuaira zama wero gayawi seka wero nowera awa. Bua ago ine awa ema nogo wai meni wai te wamunoi?

Nakare be doena wai tepo, duba daimatare noise Anutura berata Anutura giti mokara Kristora nana desenitinoise ge tugata inowenakare, nakare ago ine ami gege bua awa wai te inoya. Nakare ema eni dainiro meni inowera ago ine oko inowenakare. Nukare Anutura ge tugata waira bua awa gawera moni tamaira bua nusokare inowia.
